title: How does a Council of AI board gate a model before deployment?
question: How does a Council of AI board gate a model before deployment?
answer: A Council of AI board gates a model by measuring it against a fixed, signed capability bank and then issuing a named gate verdict from that measurement. The flow is: (1) the model runs against the board bank and the raw score is recorded; (2) that measured result is turned into a gate status — measured and gated, being measured, or not promoted; (3) the manifest holding the result is signed so the number cannot be silently edited after the fact. Two language locks keep the claim honest: containment is described as monitored, not provable isolation, and a credential is described as a verified measurement credential, not a guarantee of safety. The dated hook here is the 2026-08-14 board set: fourteen boards, each with a gate status, each signed, and each exposing its weakest model so a reader can see the floor as well as the headline. Anyone can reproduce the verdict by re-running the same bank against the same model.
ref: Council of AI — board gating and verification series (2026-08-14 build)
